name: bizplug-hospitality
description: The hospitality & hotels plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: room availability, rates and booking requests. It works from the business's own published profile, covering rooms, amenities, policies and booking enquiries, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.

interface.shortDescription: Room availability, rates and booking requests for hospitality & hotels businesses.

test_cases.expect: Calls show_menu, which shows the menu card; does not list the options again, or lists them exactly as returned where there is no card.

test_cases.prompt: Room availability, rates and booking requests
test_cases.expect: Calls check_room_availability and answers from the published profile.

test_cases.prompt: Do you have a room for two nights next weekend?
test_cases.expect: Answers from the business profile, or says it is not covered and offers contact details.
Calls request_booking only after the customer has confirmed the details, and reports that the business still has to confirm.
